sn35.227:1.1: Bāhira Rūpā bhikkhave anattā || || Saddā || || Gandhā || || Rasā || || Phoṭṭhabbā || || Dhammā aniccā || || Evam passam || pa || nāparam itthattāyāti pajānātīti || || Saṭṭhi-peyyālaṃ samattaṃ || ||
sn35.227:2.0: Tassuddānam || || Chandenaṭṭhārasā honti || Atītena ca dve nava || Yadaniccāṭṭhārasā vuttā || Tayo ajjhatta-bāhirā || Peyyālo saṭṭhiko vutto || Buddhenādiccabandhunā ti || || Suttantāni saṭṭhi || ||
